en.headline: Urban Renewal Authority records HK$338 million surplus for 2025/26
en.dek: The authority returned to profit in its silver jubilee year and is preparing an enhanced tender service to help owners engage consultants and contractors for building works.
body: The Urban Renewal Authority reported an operating surplus of HK$338 million for the 2025/26 financial year, reversing earlier losses, chairman Chow Chung-kong said at the organisation’s 25th anniversary ceremony on Friday.

Chief Executive John Lee, who officiated at the event, said the government is reviewing the authority’s overall financial and operational model, including acquisition policies and strategies for older districts. He noted three measures announced in last year’s Policy Address that use newly developed land to create incentives for urban renewal.

Chow said one near-term priority is finalising details with the government of an enhanced “tender facilitation” service to give owners stronger support when appointing engineering consultants and contractors. He emphasised that the rapid ageing of both buildings and districts requires coordinated efforts by government, the private sector, professionals and the community.

zh.headline: 市建局2025/26年度轉虧為盈 錄3.38億元盈餘
zh.dek: 銀禧年恢復盈利，正與政府敲定「加強版招標妥」服務細節，加強支援業主聘用顧問及承建商。
body: 市區重建局周五在25周年銀禧慶典上公布，2025/26財政年度錄得3.38億元營運盈餘，成功轉虧為盈。主席周松崗表示，面對外圍環境及物業市場波動，市建局以靈活策略善用資源達成目標。
行政長官李家超出席並主禮，指政府正與市建局檢討整體財務和營運模式，包括收購政策及推動舊區更新策略。他提到去年《施政報告》公布的三項措施，以創新思維利用新發展土地增加市場誘因，加快市區更新步伐。
周松崗指未來工作重點之一是加緊籌備「加強版招標妥」服務，現正與政府敲定具體措施及執行細節，以加強對業主招聘工程顧問及承建商的支援。他強調舊區及樓宇急速雙老化，須凝聚政府、商界、專業界別及地區人士力量共同應對。
